title: The paid WhatsApp code limit gives no warning before it is reached
what: When the older 'we send you a code' way is on, every code is a paid WhatsApp message. There is a cap of 200 a day for everyone. Nobody is warned as it gets close. When it is reached, the only sign is one line in the server log, and code sign-up and Forgot PIN quietly vanish from the panel until midnight.
expected: MettleUp gets a warning on Needs you or by message at about 80% of the day's cap, and again when sending stops, with the count for the day.
who: MettleUp, and owners who forgot their PIN
how_often: only while the send-a-code way is switched on and a busy day passes 200 codes
fix_line: Raise an alert to MettleUp at 80% and at 100% of the day's code cap

title: A full device throws away the desk's offline copy of the gym with no word to the desk
what: Each time the panel updates the copy of the gym kept for no-internet days, it first deletes the old copy, then writes the new one. When the device is out of space the write fails, so the device is left with no copy at all. Only a hidden log line notes it. The next time the internet drops, the panel cannot open members or dues, though the desk believed it could.
expected: The old copy stays until the new one is safely written (one step), and the desk sees a warning that this device can no longer work offline.
how_often: whenever the desk device's storage is full
fix_line: Replace the copy in one step and tell the desk when it could not be kept

title: Payments waiting to be sent can be wiped by the browser when the device runs low on space
what: Payments, check-ins and new members taken with no internet wait in the browser's own store. The panel never asks the browser to keep that store for good and never checks how much space is left. Under low space a browser may clear a site's store, taking unsent receipts with it, and the desk gets no warning beforehand.
expected: The panel asks the browser to keep its store, checks free space, and warns the desk early when space is low while anything is waiting to be sent.
how_often: rarely: low disk on the desk device while offline items wait
fix_line: Ask the browser to keep the store and warn when space is low

title: A gym kept only in this browser hits its space limit with no early warning
what: A gym kept only in the browser has about 5 MB. The panel says 'This browser is full' only when a save already failed, maybe in the middle of taking a payment. Backup copies of unreadable data are kept for ever in the same space and are never cleared.
expected: A warning when the browser gym is about 80% full, pointing to 'put your records online', and old backups cleared after they were downloaded or after a time.
how_often: once a browser-only gym has years of records
fix_line: Warn early when the browser gym is nearly full and clear old backups

title: If the gym server's storage limit is reached, every desk only sees 'Something went wrong'
what: When the gym server reaches its plan's storage limit it stops taking new records. The panel has no words for this: every save at every gym shows 'Something went wrong. Please try again.', so staff keep retrying and owners cannot tell it is not their fault. Unsent offline items do stay kept.
expected: A clear message that MettleUp is having a problem and the records are kept and will go later, plus an alert to MettleUp.
how_often: only if the database reaches its plan limit (about 18 MB of 500 MB now)
fix_line: Show a plain 'MettleUp problem, your records are kept' message for server-full errors
